'''Marni''' was the former [[Marriage|wife]] of the [[banker]] [[Tay Kolma]].<ref name="Sagrona Teema" /> Shortly before the [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] of [[Leida Mothma]] and [[Stekan Sculdun]] in [[4 BBY]], Marni and Kolma began to "live apart" from one another, which the latter noted to his friend, the [[Chandrilan]] [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]], who had been unaware of this development when she asked about his wife's whereabouts. According to Kolma, his separation had become a source of some gossip<ref name="One Year Later" /> and Mothma's husband [[Perrin Fertha]] later claimed that Marni had run off, leaving his partner free to pursue the relationship that he believed she was having with Kolma.<ref name="Sagrona Teema" /> Along with the collapse of several business interests,<ref name="One Year Later" /> his separation with Marni caused Tay Kolma to become resentful towards Mothma, who he tried to blackmail with his knowledge about her involvement with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|fledgling rebellion]] taking shape against the [[Galactic Empire]], although he was [[Death|silenced]] by a [[Cinta Kaz|member]] of the [[Axis network]] before he could make good on his threat.<ref name="Harvest">{{Andor|Harvest}}</ref>
